question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Compact
solution: The correct answer is **"Expand."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Compact"** means small and easy to carry. (छोटा और उठाकर ले जाने में सुविधाजनक) • **Example**: *She uses a compact camera.* • The antonym of **Compact** is **Expand**. • The word** "Expand"** means to become or make larger in size, volume, or quantity. (फैलना या फैलाना) • **Example**: *The company plans to **expand**__ its operations to other countries.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Short:** It means small in length, distance, or height. (छोटा (लंबाई में)) • **Option 3, Multiple:** It means having or involving several parts, elements, or members. (बहुल, बहुविध या बहुखंड, (जिसमें अनेक लोग या वस्‍तुएँ शामिल हों या जिसके अनेक अंग खंड हों)) • **Option 4, Compress**: It means to press or squeeze something into a smaller space or size. (दबाकर भरना, संपीडित करना, संक्षिप्‍त करना) 3a:Tb8e, The correct answer is **"betterment."**
